violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED PICO AT 44- 45F, COLESLAW AT 45-46F, PORK BELLY AT 43-48F, AND PICKLES IN BUTTERMILK AT 46F IN THE ONE-DOOR PREP TOP AT THE COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED/DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. EHS OBSERVED THE COOLER BETWEEN 39- 44F. PIC WILL ENSURE THE COOLER CAN CONSISTENTLY MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F PRIOR TO USING FOR TCS FOODS AGAIN.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED GROUTING NEAR MOP SINK IN NEED OF REPAIR; OBSERVED CAULKING AT HANDWASHING SINK CLOSEST TO THE DISHWASHING MACHINE WORN.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE REPAIR THE GROUTING AND CAULKING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SINKS IN BACK KITCHEN OR BAR AREA WITH SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL SEND PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT CAN BE POSTED. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNAGE IS POSTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
